notation system of

  • CURIE: gmeow:notationSystemOf
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/notationSystemOf
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/notation
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The notation system that this projection profile describes. Functional: one notation system per projection profile.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile -> gmeow:NotationSystem; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:notationSystemOf from gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile to gmeow:NotationSystem when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile, gmeow:NotationSystem

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to name the single notation system a gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile describes — the anchor that ties a loss/parameter ledger to the concrete surface form it characterizes.

Avoid when

  • Avoid asserting more than one notation system per profile (it is functional — a different system needs its own profile) and avoid pointing it at the canonical content being projected.

How to use

  • Set exactly one gmeow:notationSystemOf on each profile; read the reverse direction through its inverse gmeow:hasNotationProjectionProfile when starting from the notation system.

Examples

  • ex:staffProfile gmeow:notationSystemOf ex:westernStaff.
